summary: Import a static inventory with group_vars and host_vars using `awx-manage inventory_import --source=inventory/ --inventory-name="My Controller Inventory"`.
questions: How do I import group_vars and host_vars into controller?
Import existing static inventory into AAP

answer_card.title: Import inventory with vars
answer_card.answer_md:
Layout:
```
inventory/
├── group_vars/mygroup
├── host_vars/myhost
└── hosts
```
```bash
awx-manage inventory_import --source=inventory/ \
  --inventory-name="My Controller Inventory"
```
